ENUMERATION_SET NAME="EM_MINI" FIXED=F
 user="TEST" time=1700000000/* "14-Nov-2023" */
{
  DESCRIPTION="EM setpoints for Module Class _EM-MINI-CL"
  ENTRY VALUE=0 NAME="HOLD" { }
  ENTRY VALUE=1 NAME="RUN" { }
  ENTRY VALUE=255 NAME="Undefined" { SELECTABLE=F }
}
FUNCTION_BLOCK_TEMPLATE NAME="CND" { DESCRIPTION="Condition" }
FUNCTION_BLOCK_DEFINITION NAME="__AAAA0000_00000001__" CATEGORY=""
{
  DESCRIPTION="Run Composite for HOLD Command"
  ATTRIBUTE NAME="CFM_MAX_TIME" TYPE=FLOAT { GROUP="Configuration" }
  SFC_ALGORITHM
  {
    GRAPHICS ALGORITHM=SFC { BOX_GRAPHIC { NAME="x" } }
    STEP NAME="S0000"
    {
      DESCRIPTION="Start"
      RECTANGLE= { X=1 Y=2 H=3 W=4 }
      ACTION NAME="A0010"
      {
        DESCRIPTION="Set Message"
        ACTION_TYPE=ASSIGN
        EXPRESSION="'^/MSG1.CV' := ""Hold"";
'^/MONITOR/SM_01.CV' := TRUE;"
        DELAY_TIME=0
      }
      ACTION NAME="EXIT"
      {
        DESCRIPTION="Clear Messages"
        EXPRESSION="'^/MSG1.CV' := """";"
        DELAY_EXPRESSION="REM Other Step Actions Complete
'S0000/PENDING_CONFIRMS.CV' = 1"
      }
    }
    INITIAL_STEP="S0000"
    TRANSITION NAME="END" { DESCRIPTION="Command" "Complete" TERMINATION=T EXPRESSION="TRUE" }
    STEP_TRANSITION_CONNECTION STEP="S0000" TRANSITION="END" { }
  }
}
FUNCTION_BLOCK_DEFINITION NAME="__AAAA0000_00000009__" CATEGORY=""
{
  DESCRIPTION="EM Fail Monitor"
  FUNCTION_BLOCK NAME="HM01" DEFINITION="CND" { DESCRIPTION="Condition" }
  ATTRIBUTE_INSTANCE NAME="HM01/DESC" { VALUE { CV="Module Ownership Lost" } }
}

{
  DESCRIPTION="Test valve class"
  ATTRIBUTE NAME="OPEN" TYPE=UINT8 { CONNECTION=INTERNAL_SOURCE }
}
